A new House bill could enable wrongfully detained U.S. citizens to sue ICE
item.description: The Yappie · The legislation comes after federal immigration agents wrongfully detained over 500 U.S. citizens since the start of President Trump’s second term.

item.title: Jail cooperation hasn’t slowed community ICE arrests, data shows
item.description: The Yappie · The Trump administration pledged to draw back operations in cities and states that cooperated with ICE, but daily ICE arrests have surged.
